affiliate.commission_note: Commission is set, calculated and paid by Deriv under Deriv's affiliate terms, directly into your Deriv affiliate account. KonfluenX does not pay, hold or forward this commission.

ib.name: KonfluenX IB Program
ib.tagline: Link your Deriv account to our IB.
ib.summary: Ask Deriv support to link your trading account to the KonfluenX IB. Once we verify the link you get a Partner Badge and become eligible for KonfluenX rewards based on your qualifying trading activity.
benefits: Link your Deriv account to our IB
Get a Partner Badge on your profile
Earn KonfluenX rewards from qualifying trading activity
Full guidance on how to link your account

pipeline.label: Not Linked
pipeline.text: Your Deriv account is not linked to the KonfluenX IB yet.

pipeline.label: Instructions Viewed
pipeline.text: You have the message template. Send it to Deriv support.

pipeline.label: User Submitted
pipeline.text: You told us your request has been sent to Deriv.

pipeline.label: Verification Pending
pipeline.text: KonfluenX is confirming the link with Deriv. This usually takes 1 to 3 business days.

pipeline.label: Verified
pipeline.text: Your account is linked to the KonfluenX IB. Your Partner Badge is live.

ib.message_template:
Hello Deriv Support,

Please link my Deriv account {loginid} to the KonfluenX IB (partner code {ib_code}).

Please confirm once this has been done.

Thank you,
{name}

steps.title: Copy the message
steps.text: It already includes your Deriv login ID and the KonfluenX IB code.

steps.title: Open Deriv live chat
steps.text: Log in to Deriv and open Live chat from the Help Centre.

steps.title: Paste and send
steps.text: Ask the agent to link your account to the KonfluenX IB. Keep the chat reference.

steps.title: Tell us it's sent
steps.text: Tap "I've submitted my request". KonfluenX then verifies the link with Deriv.

ib.note: Linking does not move your funds or change how you trade. It only records with Deriv that your account is introduced by KonfluenX.

rewards.rule: IB rewards are KX Points, credited monthly from qualifying trading activity on your linked account. KonfluenX sets the qualifying rules and may change them. Points can never be bought.

referral.name: KonfluenX Referral Program
referral.summary: Invite people to join KonfluenX. Earn 20% of the platform fees KonfluenX collects from them, for life, subject to the programme terms.
benefits: Lifetime benefit on every user you refer
terms: You earn 20% of the platform fee KonfluenX keeps on each payment a referred user makes, not 20% of what they pay.
Earnings stay pending for 14 days so refunds and chargebacks can settle, then become available.
Available earnings are paid out on the 1st of each month.
The benefit lasts for the life of the referred user's account while the programme runs, subject to the programme terms.
Self-referrals, duplicate accounts and incentivised sign-ups are not eligible and can lead to earnings being withheld.
